steps.what: Tried eight Brussels keys from the same series.
Two agents transcribed every cipher line and margin line from the images.
Anchors from n-grams repeated across letters, checked against the margin text.
Hard-EM monotone aligner of tokens to margin plaintext, seeded by the anchors; converged in two rounds.
Key applied to the four letters with no margin.
Key reproduces the ten margins; Ghent's fall (9 Mar 1678) appears in R998.

outcome.method: key recovered based on adjacent plaintext
outcome.method_basis: No key survives; the syllabic nomenclator was rebuilt by a seeded EM aligner from the contemporary marginal decipherments on 10 of the 14 letters (R985-R998) and then read the four letters with no margin.
outcome.notes: Four previously unread letters read in gist.
